description: This file defines the ModuleService class responsible for handling CRUD operations, retrieval, and response formatting for modules within the SuiteCRM application, including handling file uploads and access control.

classes.name: ModuleService
classes.description: Service class providing CRUD operations, retrieval, and response handling for module entities within SuiteCRM, including file handling and access control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies such as BeanManager and various helpers.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a single module record by ID, performing access control checks.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Retrieves multiple module records, supports filtering, sorting, pagination, and special email-related logic.

methods.name: createRecord
methods.description: Creates a new module record, handling file uploads and access rights.

methods.name: updateRecord
methods.description: Updates existing module record, including handling file uploads and access control.

methods.name: deleteRecord
methods.description: Deletes (soft delete) a module record with access checks.

methods.name: getDataResponse
methods.description: Formats a SugarBean into a DataResponse object with attributes and relationships.

methods.name: addFileToDocument
methods.description: Handles adding a file to a document record, including saving file contents and creating a revision.

methods.name: addFileToNote
methods.description: Handles adding a file to a note, including saving file contents and updating file metadata.

methods.name: processAttributes
methods.description: Processes input attributes, updates bean properties, and handles file contents presence.

methods.name: setRecordUpdateParams
methods.description: Sets modification and creation-related parameters on the bean based on input attributes.
